sentences.text:
This application coming on for this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER
This is the first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 15-11- 2022 by Police Station Kotwali Shivpuri District-Shivpuri (MP) in connection with Crime No. 198/2021 registered in relation to the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(3) of IPC and section 5 (tha)/6 of POCSO Act.

It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is suffering confinement since 15-11-2022 and material witness including prosecutrix and her father have already been examined,
therefore, chance of tempering with evidence/ witnesses is remote.

He refers the statements of the prosecutrix to indicate that it was a consensual relationship and they both have entered into wedlock Madhav@ Madho@ Bhura vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37410479/
1 and now living as a couple.

entities.text: Madhav@ Madho@ Bhura vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: They are also blessed with a child.
Applicant bears no criminal antecedents.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial.
He also undertakes to take care of prosecutrix properly as her wife.
On these grounds learned counsel prays for grant of bail.

Learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of the bail application, however, he does dispute the fact as regards solemnization of marriage between prosecutrix and applicant .
Heard.
Perused the case diary.
A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible for the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
